description: Tag Pilot tracking-health check. Shows how sessions split by default channel group and flags attribution problems: the share of "Unassigned" sessions (with their top source/medium pairs), "(not set)" source, "(not set)" landing page (sessions without a page_view/session_start, often server-side or Measurement Protocol hits without session data, or consent mode pings) and a very high Direct share (lost referrers/UTMs). Uses 4 runReport calls.

date_range.description: Default: last 28 full days (28daysAgo to yesterday).

name.description: Optional label; shows up as the "dateRange" column when you pass several ranges.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID, e.g. "123456789" or "properties/123456789" (not the G-XXXX measurement ID). get_account_summaries lists them.

name: check_traffic_attribution
title: Tag Pilot check: unassigned and (not set) traffic
